arithmetic.formula: need 0.1677 × matvec_code_bytes 7904952704 = 1325660568 bytes. MEASURED conventional (Shannon on MLP codes) supplies 277697891 (3.5130% of the codes). UNTESTED conventional adds uniform Q3 on attention/DeltaNet codes 904724480 for a total 1182422371 (14.9580%). Both are short of 16.7700%.
arithmetic.why_aux_does_not_count_here: broadcast_aux bills at 0.000 ms/GB. After arithmetic removal the 15.269 ms is the binding stream. Shrinking scale/bias saves payload SIZE, not the 15.27 ms.

sixty.what_class_of_change_could: INFORMATION ELIMINATION — a smaller executable program for the same function — or removing work that is not a matvec (DeltaNet state update / rearrange / gated norm, ~2.0 ms; host time). Ordinary coding of the stored q has single-digit percent of the MLP codes (0.277698 GB, 6.49% of that body) and cannot supply 16.8% of matvec weight bytes.

what_is_estimated: ms_saved for every payload cut is billed at the stream-class rate (not a complete-token re-measure of a new packing). HQ30UQ4 split of GQA/lm_head/embed applies the DeltaNet-measured 4-bit / group-64 / 40-byte-header layout to census storage_bytes; MIX_REPORT names that codec on the hardlinked q4 tensors. Uniform Q3 byte counts are 1/4 of those codes, not a fitted Q3 artifact. Combining arithmetic removal with byte removal is the composition caveat already on GAP_LEDGER_60.
what_is_measured: MIX_REPORT payload split; catalog census organ bytes; stream-class ms/GB; MLP i.i.d. Shannon of the 2-bit codes; group_size_256/1024 FAILED_HELDOUT; composite linear low-rank scar; q2/q4 bitcast gpu_ms_saved; arm_a 52.008 TPS still 2.56 ms short of 60; USB quiet-cold 77.7 MB/s; aux-u8 native projected_mlp_delta_ms > 0.

worth_it.cost_basis: S025: spend an hour only if a perfect win is >= 1.0 ms/token, or >= 5-10% of important bytes. Shannon-coding the MLP codes is 6.49% of that 4.27819 GB body (True on the size bar) and 0.151979 ms/token billed at weight_codes 0.547282 ms/GB (False on the time bar). Every UNTESTED non-overlapping payload move still bills 0.821072 ms/token because the large aux cuts are 0.000 ms/GB and the Q3 code cut is a fraction of a millisecond. Neither reaches 60 TPS.
worth_it.why: Another conventional compression campaign is not worth running as a 60-TPS lever. The only MEASURED byte cut on the binding stream is 0.277698 GB of MLP-code histogram bias, billed 0.151979 ms/token if a fused decoder existed and 0.000 if it rematerializes. Aux cuts (2.25 / G=128 / u8) are SIZE, measured 0.000 ms/GB, and the native u8 path was slower. G=256 and G=1024 are capability-REFUTED. Uniform Q3 of attention/DeltaNet is UNTESTED and still leaves the 16.8% matvec-byte cut short. The bitcast levers are TIME not SIZE and are already measured.
